section.title: Legacy Data Migration
section.para: This section is intended for server administrators migrating from older jaymod versions or other mods that used text-based .db files or shrubbot.cfg.
&project:name; uses a SQLite database (xmod.db) for all persistent data. Legacy data from text-based user.db files can be imported using:
This will migrate user records from the legacy format into the SQLite database. The original files are preserved and not modified.
